newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan rogue bond trader to publish tell-all book.
newsitem.headline: Japan rogue bond trader to publish tell-all book.

text.p: A leading Japanese publisher will release next week a personal account by Toshihide Iguchi, the key figure in Daiwa Bank's massive bond trading loss scandal in the United States, the firm said on Monday.

"The Confession", a Japanese-language book detailing how Iguchi lost nearly $1 billion in unauthorised U.S. bond trading over 11 years, will be released on January 16, publisher Bungei Shunju Ltd. said.

Last month, Iguchi, a former bond trader at Daiwa's New York branch, was sentenced to four years in prison and fined $2 million for his role in the scandal, which forced the bank to close down its U.S. operations and caused friction between U.S. and Japanese financial authorities.
